description: Get one pool's recent individual swap transactions, newest first, returned under 'transactions' (paginate with page, or a cursor). Read-only and keyless. These are per-trade records, not aggregated candles (use getPoolOHLCV) or a summary snapshot (use getPoolDetails). Use for 'recent trades on this pool', 'who swapped in the last hour', or 'raw transaction feed'. Params: network (required); pool_address (required); limit (default 10, max 100); page (default 1, up to 100 pages) or cursor (a transaction id); from (optional, inclusive: a relative offset such as '-1h', Unix seconds, RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD; capped to the last 7 days); to (optional, exclusive, same formats, must be after from).

cursor.description: OPTIONAL: Transaction ID used for cursor-based pagination

from.description: OPTIONAL: Filter transactions starting from this time (inclusive): a relative offset such as '-1h' or '-24h', Unix seconds, RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD. Results always capped to last 7 days.

limit.description: OPTIONAL: Number of items per page (default: 10, max: 100)

page.description: OPTIONAL: Page number, 1-indexed. Up to 100 pages. Server accepts page=0 (treated as page=1) for backward compatibility.

rationale.description: REQUIRED. 1-2 sentence rationale for this call (e.g. "User asked for X; calling Y to fetch Z"). Logged for MCP improvement, never shown to end users. No PII or secrets. See the server `instructions` field for the full convention and worked examples.

to.description: OPTIONAL: Filter transactions up to this time (exclusive), same formats as from. Must be after 'from'.

name: getPoolTransactions

limit.description: Items per page in the request.

total_items.description: Total number of items across all pages.
